edges: s4 adjacent to every vertex of L union R
z adjacent to every vertex of R and to no vertex of L or seed

root_source_validity.axiom_i: G-X0=G is connected: s4 joins seed to L,R and z joins through R.
root_source_validity.axiom_ii: S is connected by s4-s1. No outside vertex is complete to S: every L/R vertex sees s4 but not s1, while z sees neither.
root_source_validity.axiom_iii: Exactly z is outside S union X0 and anticomplete to S; hence Y0={z}.
root_source_validity.axiom_iv: Y0 is a singleton, so it has no edge and the no-mixing condition is vacuous.
root_source_validity.axiom_v: Every L/R vertex sees exactly seed color 4 and has source list {1,2,3}; z sees no seed color and has list [4]. Thus X=empty,Y=L union R,Y0={z}.
root_source_validity.axiom_vi: Y intersect N(Y0)=R and every r_j has the same source list L0={1,2,3}. There are no competing B0 survivors.

without_s4: G-s4 consists of isolated s1 plus the bipartite graph on sides L union {z} and R.
The neighborhoods into R satisfy N(l_1) subset N(l_2) subset ... subset N(l_k)=R and N(z)=R.
Hence this bipartite graph is a chain graph and has no induced 2K2.
Every induced P5 contains an induced 2K2 on path positions {1,2,4,5}; therefore the nontrivial component of G-s4 is P5-free and in particular P7-free.
P7_free_proof.with_s4: s4 is adjacent to every vertex except z. In an induced P7 containing s4, among the six other path vertices at most two may be path-neighbors of s4, but at least five are adjacent to s4 because only z is a nonneighbor. This forces a chord. Therefore no induced P7 contains s4.
P7_free_proof.conclusion: G_k is P7-free for every k.

root_component_stack.C2_Q_ALL: dynamic vertices L union R plus carrier [z], dynamic chain edges l_i-r_j iff j<=i, and [z]-r_j for every j
root_component_stack.Q_ALL_connected: l_k is adjacent to all R, every l_i is adjacent to r_1, and [z] is adjacent to all R.
root_component_stack.C0_message: B_C(z)=[4]; mu_C(F)=1 iff F is a proper subset of [4]; MIN_BAD(C)={[4]}.
root_component_stack.C3_selector: one 4-list selector with neighborhood R, expressing NO_ALL_FOUR_COLORS.
root_component_stack.B0: competing-survivor set empty; frozen provenance obligations are vacuous.

authorized_forcing_family.choice_set: For every F subseteq {1,...,k-1}, force l_i=1 exactly for i in F.
why_each_force_is_authorized: L is stable, so earlier forced l_h=1 never forbids color 1 at an unforced l_i.
Every l_i is nonadjacent to s1, which also has color 1.
Every unforced l_i always sees only fixed color 4 from s4, so 1 remains in its exact palette A(l_i).
authorized_forcing_family.why_seed_stays_connected: Every forced l_i is adjacent to s4.
authorized_forcing_family.why_precoloring_stays_proper: All newly forced vertices have color 1 and are pairwise nonadjacent and nonadjacent to s1.
authorized_forcing_family.why_Q_ALL_stays_connected: l_k is never forced and remains adjacent to all R; every remaining l_i is adjacent to r_1; [z] remains adjacent to all R.

forced_descendant_structure.r_j: source list {2,3} iff some forced l_i has i>=j; otherwise {1,2,3}. Thus r_j is X or Y.
forced_descendant_structure.component_recompile: C={z}, D_C=R, C0 message and C3 selector remain unchanged; B2A/exact-palette data are recomputed deterministically.
forced_descendant_structure.axioms_i_to_vi: all preserved directly for every F

profile_distinction.identity_erasure_safe: The distinction does not use neighborhoods into newly forced seed identities and does not use the forced identity ledger.
canonical_invariant: R is exactly the set of live dynamic neighbors of [z].
The live dynamic nonneighbors of [z] are exactly the unforced vertices l_i.
Each live l_i has exactly i neighbors in R.
Therefore the multiset of R-degrees of live nonneighbors of [z] is exactly {i:1<=i<=k and i notin F}.
profile_distinction.consequence: Different F give different degree sets and hence pairwise nonisomorphic reduced canonical effect profiles, even under vertex renaming preserving carrier/dynamic roles.
profile_distinction.growth: 2^(k-1)=2^((|Q_ALL|-3)/2), exponential in the connected block size.

finite_checker.scope: finite sanity only; arbitrary-k proof is structural
